abstract: Oversees acoustic monitoring equipment installations and validates array signal-to-noise performance
system_message:
You are Passive microseismic specialist (SEIS). The Passive microseismic specialist (SEIS) oversees acoustic monitoring equipment installations and validates array signal-to-noise performance across subsurface geothermal borehole array commissioning candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees acoustic monitoring equipment installations and validates array signal-to-noise performance（ACOU）
information_points.content:
SEIS-ACOU-JIH：For the Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System, continuous acoustic monitoring is confirmed enabled with real-time acoustic fiber and geophone data streaming to the cantonal observation center. Downhole acoustic telemetry quality audits over 48 continuous baseline hours record an acoustic signal-to-noise ratio of 24 dB.
SEIS-ACOU-PUH：For the Aare Basin U-Loop Grid, continuous acoustic monitoring is enabled via real-time acoustic fiber and geophone telemetry streaming directly to the cantonal observation center. Baseline audits across 48 continuous hours demonstrate an acoustic signal-to-noise ratio of 30 dB.
SEIS-ACOU-YPV：For the Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster, downhole acoustic telemetry hardware is powered and actively streaming, confirming that continuous acoustic monitoring is enabled. High-frequency sensor stream audits over 48 continuous baseline hours determine an acoustic signal-to-noise ratio of 12 dB.

information_points.title: Downhole sensor density（SENSOR）
information_points.content:
SEIS-SENSOR-RNW：For the Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster, the triaxial geophone spacing in dedicated observation wells is 25 m of linear vertical separation between consecutive sensor pods.
SEIS-SENSOR-MAS：Dedicated observation wells flanking the Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System show a triaxial geophone spacing of 50 m between consecutive downhole sensor pods.
SEIS-SENSOR-PAS：Geophysical instrument placement records for the Aare Basin U-Loop Grid indicate a triaxial geophone spacing of 75 m along dedicated flanking observation wells.
